tour_blurb: Forty-nine is Tower Studio — the creative atelier. Drafts, mock-ups, layouts, and visual experiments take shape here, with light streaming in through the big windows. If a floor upstairs needs a fresh look or a polished surface, the Studio is where the brief lands first.

live_signals.service_description: QSB Tower Studio — Floor 49 public-facing studio (port 8849)

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F49 Tower Studio runs as a USER-scope systemd unit (qsb-tower-studio.service on port 8849), not system-scope — `systemctl is-active` from a non-user shell returns 'not-found'; always probe with `systemctl --user`. /healthz returns {ok:true,service:tower_studio}; /api/state is NOT wired (404) — take the page <title> off `GET /` for live brand-signal instead. Note the floor identity lives at floors/floor_49_tower_studio/ for the visitor-facing studio brand; the legacy floors/floor_49_resource_management_department/ is a separate internal-ops floor that shares the number 49 and is unrelated to this card.
